answer: Sybil resistance can be anchored to where rewards end up. Keys paying out to one withdrawal address, or forwarding earnings to it within three hops, form a cluster, and the k-th key in a cluster keeps 25×k² POA bonded: four keys lock 750 combined, yet 1,000 lock over 8.3 billion, about ten full epochs of issuance. An echo check traces payouts that return to a shared wallet; the raven, a watcher key posting that trace, earns 5% of any bond slashed. A bond funded as a mirror of a loan from its own cluster is slashed too. Weakness: separate cash-out paths, costing a farm liquidity.
